maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is commissions on selling and renewing insurance policies through agencies, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Commissions come from private insurance carriers, paid by consumers and small businesses for auto, home, life and commercial policies.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through a network of independent agencies and agents it recruits and supports, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Customers can move policies to another agent or carrier fairly easily; the agency shops hundreds of carriers for personal and small commercial coverage.
